# 1 Chronicles Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 377r–378r

---

**12:1** And-these [are] the-ones-coming to David at-Tsiqlag, while-still shut-up [atsor] from-before Sha'ul son of-Qish; and-they [were] among the-mighty-men [ha-gibborim], helpers [ozrei] of-the-battle [milchamah]. **12:2** Armed [noshqei] of-bow, right-handing and-left-handing [mayminim u-mas'ilim] with-stones and-with-arrows [chitstsim] by-the-bow, from-the-brothers of-Sha'ul, from-Binyamin.

**12:3** The-chief [ha-rosh] Achi'ezer, and-Yo'ash, sons of-ha-Shema'ah the-Giv'ati, and-Yezi'el and-Pelet, sons of-Azmavet, and-Berakhah, and-Yehu the-Anatoti, **12:4** and-Yishmayah the-Giv'oni — a-mighty-man [gibbor] among the-thirty and-over the-thirty — and-Yirmeyah, and-Yachazi'el, and-Yochanan, and-Yozavad the-Gederati, **12:5** El'uzai, and-Yerimot, and-Be'alyah, and-Shemaryahu, and-Shefatyahu the-Charufi, **12:6** Elqanah, and-Yishiyyahu, and-Azar'el, and-Yo'ezer, and-Yashov'am, the-Qorchim, **12:7** and-Yo'elah and-Zevadyah, sons of-Yerocham from the-Gedor.

**12:8** And-from the-Gadi separated-themselves [nivdelu] to David, to-the-stronghold [ha-metsudah], to-the-wilderness, mighty-men of-valor [gibborei chayil], men of-the-army [anshei tsava] for-the-battle, arranging [orkhei] shield [tsinah] and-spear [romach]; and-faces of-a-lion [penei aryeh] their-faces, and-as-gazelles [ki-tsvi'ot] on the-mountains to-be-swift [le-maheir].

**12:9** Ezer the-chief [ha-rosh], Ovadyah the-second, Eli'av the-third, **12:10** Mashmannah the-fourth, Yirmeyah the-fifth, **12:11** Attai the-sixth, Eli'el the-seventh, **12:12** Yochanan the-eighth, Elzavad the-ninth, **12:13** Yirmeyahu the-tenth, Makhbannai the-eleventh. **12:14** These from-the-sons of-Gad [were] chiefs [rashei] of-the-army [ha-tsava]; the-least [ha-qaton] for-a-hundred and-the-greatest [ha-gadol] for-a-thousand. **12:15** These [are] they who-crossed the-Yarden in-the-first month [ba-chodesh ha-rishon], when-it-was filling [memalle] over all its-banks [gidotav], and-they-put-to-flight all [those in] the-valleys, to-the-east and-to-the-west.

**12:16** And-came from the-sons of-Binyamin and-Yehudah to the-stronghold to David. **12:17** And-went-out David before-them and-answered and-said to-them: If for-peace [le-shalom] you-come to-me, to-help-me, there-shall-be to-me upon-you a-heart [levav] to-unite [le-yachad]; and-if to-betray-me [le-rammoteni] to-my-adversaries [le-tsarai] — with-no wrong [chamas] in-my-hands — may-see the-God of-our-fathers and-rebuke [yokhi'ach].

**12:18** And-spirit [ruach] clothed [lavshah] Amasai, chief [rosh] of-the-thirty [ha-sheloshim]: Yours [lekha], David! And-with-you [immekha], son of-Yishay! Peace, peace [shalom shalom] to-you, and-peace to-your-helper [ozrekha], for your-God helps-you [azarekha]. And-received-them David and-set-them among-the-chiefs [rashei] of-the-troop [ha-gedud].

**12:19** And-from Menashe fell [naflu] to David when-he-came with the-Pelishtim against Sha'ul for-battle — and-not did-they-help-them, for by-counsel [be-etsah] the-lords [sarnei] of-the-Pelishtim sent-him-away, saying: At [the cost of] our-heads [be-roshenu] he-will-fall to his-lord [adonav] Sha'ul. **12:20** When-he-went to-Tsiqlag there-fell to-him from-Menashe: Adnach, and-Yozavad, and-Yedi'a'el, and-Mikha'el, and-Yozavad, and-Elihu, and-Tsilletai — chiefs [rashei] of-the-thousands [alafim] who [were] of-Menashe. **12:21** And-they helped with [im] David against the-raiding-band [ha-gedud], for mighty-men of-valor [gibborei chayil] [were] all of-them, and-they-became commanders [sarim] in-the-army [ba-tsava].

**12:22** For at-time by-time [le-et be-et] they-came to David to-help-him, until [it was] a-great camp [machaneh gadol], like-a-camp [ke-machaneh] of-God [elohim].

**12:23** And-these [are] the-numbers [misperei] of-the-chiefs [rashei] of-the-equipped [he-chaluts] for-the-army [la-tsava]; they-came to David at-Chevron to-turn [le-hasev] the-kingdom of-Sha'ul to-him, according-to the-mouth [ke-fi] of-YHWH.

**12:24** The-sons of-Yehudah, bearers of-shield [tsinah] and-spear [romach]: six thousand and-eight hundred, equipped [chalutsim] for-the-army. **12:25** From the-sons of-Shim'on, mighty-men of-valor [gibborei chayil] for-the-army: seven thousand and-one-hundred. **12:26** From the-sons of-Levi: four thousand and-six-hundred. **12:27** And-Yehoyada the-leader [ha-nagid] for-Aharon, and-with-him three-thousand and-seven-hundred. **12:28** And-Tsadoq, a-young-man [na'ar], mighty of-valor [gibbor chayil], and-his-father's house — twenty-two commanders [sarim].

**12:29** And-from the-sons of-Binyamin, the-brothers of-Sha'ul: three thousand — and-until then the-majority [marbittam] of-them were-keeping [shomrim] the-charge [mishmeret] of-the-house of-Sha'ul. **12:30** And-from the-sons of-Efrayim: twenty thousand and-eight-hundred, mighty-men of-valor [gibborei chayil], men of-renown [anshei shemot] of-the-house of-their-fathers.

**12:31** And-from the-half-tribe of-Menashe: eighteen thousand, who were-designated [niqevu] by-names to-come to-make-king David. **12:32** And-from the-sons of-Yissakhar, knowers of-understanding [yod'ei vinah] for-the-times [la-ittim], to-know what should-do Yisra'el — their-chiefs [rasheihem] two-hundred, and-all their-brothers [were] at their-command [al pihem].

**12:33** From-Zevulun, those-going-out to-the-army [yotsei tsava], arranging [orkhei] for-battle with-all instruments of-war [kelei milchamah]: fifty-thousand, and-to-arrange [la-ador] with-no double-heart [lo be-lev va-lev]. **12:34** And-from Naftali: a-thousand commanders [sarim], and-with-them with-shield [tsinah] and-spear [chanit]: thirty-seven thousand. **12:35** And-from the-Dani, arranging for-battle: twenty-eight thousand and-six-hundred. **12:36** And-from Asher, those-going-out to-the-army, to-arrange for-battle: forty-thousand. **12:37** And-from across the-Yarden, from the-Re'uveni and-the-Gadi and-the-half-tribe of-Menashe, with-all instruments of-the-army [kelei tsava] for-battle: a-hundred and-twenty thousand.

**12:38** All these men of-war [anshei milchamah], arranging in-array [adrei ma'arakhah], with-a-whole heart [be-lev shalem] they-came to-Chevron to-make-king David over all Yisra'el; and-also all the-rest of-Yisra'el [were] of-one heart [lev echad] to-make-king David. **12:39** And-they-were there with David three days, eating and-drinking, for their-brothers had-prepared for-them. **12:40** And-also those-near [ha-qerovim] to-them — unto Yissakhar and-Zevulun and-Naftali — bringing [mevi'im] food [lechem] on-donkeys and-on-camels and-on-mules and-on-cattle: provisions [ma'akhalot] of-flour [qemach], cakes-of-figs [develei te'enim], and-cakes-of-raisins [tsimmuqei anavim], and-wine [yayin], and-oil [shemen], and-cattle [baqar], and-sheep [tson] in-abundance [la-rov], for [there was] joy [simchah] in-Yisra'el.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — mayminim u-mas'ilim:** "Right-handing and left-handing" — these Benjaminite warriors could use both hands, a notable military skill also mentioned in Judges 20:16. The Chronicler underscores their elite capability.

**v.8 — penei aryeh:** "Faces of a lion" — the Gadite warriors described with leonine imagery. Combined with gazelle-like swiftness, this is heroic poetry embedded in a roster list.

**v.18 — ruach lavshah:** "Spirit clothed" — literally the spirit "put on" Amasai like a garment. This is a prophetic moment; the military declaration becomes an oracle.

**v.22 — ke-machaneh elohim:** "Like a camp of God" — a superlative expression. David's gathering at Hebron is compared to a divine army. The Chronicler builds toward the coronation as a cosmic event.

**v.32 — yod'ei vinah la-ittim:** "Knowers of understanding for the times" — Issachar's contribution is wisdom rather than military strength. This is one of the most celebrated phrases in Chronicles, implying political and perhaps prophetic discernment.

*— EMET*
